subject: Request: extend evaluation window + additional credits for Acme Health
messages:
From: Tom Matthews <tom.matthews@acmehealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 17 Apr 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Eval extension & additional credits request

Hi Vanessa (and Olga),

Thanks again for the run this week — the embeddings pipeline is exactly what our NLP team needed. We burned through the initial eval pool faster than anticipated while testing large historical datasets and privacy-preserving obfuscation workflows.

Procurement has asked for an updated SOW before they can cut a PO, and that process will take ~3–4 weeks. Given the timeline, can Redwood grant a 30-day extension on the evaluation period and top up the trial credits by an additional 2M tokens so our engineers can finish the integration tests? We won’t be able to move to a paid pilot until procurement completes the PO, which is the holdup.

If you need any justification for the internal approvers, happy to provide the integration plan or jump on a call.

Best,
Tom Matthews
Director of Engineering, Acme Health
procurement@acmehealth.com

--
Attachment: current_test_summary.csv (reference only)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 17 Apr 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Eval extension & additional credits request

Olga,

FYI — Tom just opened the procurement delay. They’ve already proven the model quality but need runway to complete integration tests. They’re asking for +30 days and ~2M token top-up. Current PLG cap prevents me from adding more credits via self-serve.

Recommendation: escalate to deal desk / exec for a one-time extension and credit grant tied to a signed PO timeline (they expect procurement to finish by mid-May). This is a mid-sized potential ARR ($120k ARR first year) and the integration makes them a strong reference in healthcare.

Key facts:
- Current eval started 2025-03-20; they’ve consumed ~65% of the initial pool in heavy embedding transforms.
- Requested extension: 30 days + 2M tokens (free credit).
- Risk: if we approve without conditions, we might create a precedent.

Can you take this up with Deal Desk / Vivek for an exec OK? I’ve attached the usage export (Acme_Eval_Usage_Q1.csv) and a proposed SOW update.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: Acme_Eval_SOW_v2.pdf

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 17 Apr 2025 11:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Exec approval request: Acme Health — 30d extension + 2M token top-up (Deal DEAL-4781)

Team,

Requesting one-time executive approval for the Acme Health evaluation extension and credit top-up. Summary below — attaching the usage export and a short SOW update for procurement.

Summary:
- Account: Acme Health (healthcare, US) — Dir. of Eng Tom Matthews is the technical champion.
- Current state: Evaluation began 2025-03-20. They’re heavily embedding historical records which consumed most of the initial credits; integration tests still outstanding.
- Ask: 30 calendar day extension + 2,000,000 token top-up (applied as free credits to the account).
- Business case: Expected first-year ARR ~$120k if pilot converts; high reference value in healthcare vertical.
- Commitment condition (recommended): extension gated on PO submission or signed SOW by the end of extension window; enable basic telemetry and billing contact in console so we can track conversion.
- Financial impact estimate: marginal token cost ~ $420 (our cost basis) — “cost” here is to the company; marketing/reference upside likely offsets.

Why escalate: This is outside standard PLG controls and requires an exec sign-off because it touches free credits policy and creates a precedent for future healthcare pilots. We propose a single-instance approval with clear conditions.

Attachments: Acme_Eval_Usage_Q1.csv (usage breakdown), Acme_Eval_SOW_v2.pdf (SOW w/ proposed delivery milestones for pilot)

Please reply with: APPROVE / APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS / DECLINE. If APPROVE, note any conditions you want enforced in the console (e.g., telemetry, PO deadline, expiry date).

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.ai

--

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>

Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 17 Apr 2025 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec approval request: Acme Health — 30d extension + 2M token top-up (Deal DEAL-4781)

Olga / Vanessa,

APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS. Thanks for the concise write-up — I’ve reviewed the usage file. I’m comfortable with a one-time grant under the following terms:

1) Grant: 30 calendar days extension + 2,000,000 tokens credited to the Acme eval account.
2) Condition: Acme must provide either a signed SOW or a procurement PO by the end of the 30-day extension. If neither is received, remaining credits will be revoked and the account will be placed on hold.
3) Condition: Enable telemetry/billing contact in the console and add a note in Deal Desk (I’ve created the record: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4781).
4) One-time exception: This approval is a single-instance deal; do not publish as policy. Record the approval in the Deal Desk thread and mark the Reason Code = "procurement_delay_exec_exception".

Vanessa — please confirm you will update the SOW with the PO deadline and log the approval in Deal Desk. Markus — please coordinate with Finance to ensure credits are accounted for.

Vivek Kulkarni
Chief Revenue Officer, Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
